mapping-campaign-hero-stage.rationale: Hero art direction and layered composition are brand/page responsibilities.

mapping-image-pill-hover-feedback.rationale: The official image face and hover choreography are a bounded brand recipe.

mapping-black-white-taxonomy-control.rationale: Taxonomy tabs are a repeatable interaction family, but the current Tabs variants cannot express this rectangular treatment without replacement markup.

mapping-product-first-catalog-density.rationale: Catalog information architecture and product density should remain host composition.

mapping-editorial-module-rhythm.rationale: News, product and event modules intentionally retain different information structures.

closure-onepiece-paper-texture.rationale: Texture layers are a brand composition recipe rather than a reusable component API.

closure-trading-card-rarity-palette.rationale: Rarity colors encode card-game data and must not inherit global action colors.

closure-environment-selector-composite.rationale: A reusable selector needs an inline or caller-owned popup container mode to avoid nested bottom sheets.

runtime-composite-field-boundary.rationale: Composite inputs need a documented and testable contract for which layer owns border and focus presentation.

runtime-theme-scope-cascade.rationale: Theme aliases need a supported scoping strategy that remains predictable inside an existing host theme root.

runtime-showcase-asset-slot.rationale: Brand-specific media and generated card-back art belong to the host recipe, but the slot must still be explicit and theme-owned.

runtime-showcase-motion-slot.rationale: Brand motion character belongs to the host recipe; DangoUI should not prescribe page-showcase choreography.
